basics.name: Priya Shah
basics.label: Product Manager
basics.summary: Product manager with seven years in consumer and public-sector services. I like small teams, short feedback loops and products people actually finish using. Most recently led the rebuild of a council's online payments, now used by 180,000 households.

work.name: Harbourside Digital
highlights: Led a team of 9 rebuilding a city council's online payments service, raising completion from 61% to 88% in six months.
Introduced fortnightly research sessions with residents, which shaped 14 of the 20 most-used changes.
Responsible for the product roadmap and quarterly planning with council stakeholders.

work.name: Fernleaf
highlights: Launched subscription pausing, cutting monthly cancellations by 23%.
Ran 40+ A/B tests on onboarding and wrote the team's experiment playbook.
Worked with finance to model pricing changes worth £1.2m a year.

work.name: Fernleaf
highlights: Owned the help centre and in-app support, answering 3,000 customer questions a month.
Built the first dashboard of support themes in Looker, now used across the company.
